snippet.title: Loose vs Pressed Eyeshadow🚨| What's The Difference EP. 8 | NykaaTV
snippet.description:
Pressed glitter vs. Loose glitter eyeshadow, what’s the real difference, and which one should you be using? In this ultimate 1.5-minute glitter eyeshadow tutorial, we’re breaking down everything you need to know to get that flawless, sparkling eye makeup look without the mess! 💖

If you are just starting out, pressed glitter eyeshadow is incredibly beginner-friendly because it already has built-in binders, meaning you can apply it directly to your lids for instant shimmer with minimal fallout. On the other hand, loose glitter eyeshadow is the go-to choice for anyone who wants a high-intensity, ultra-pigmented, and dramatic look.

However, loose glitter requires a secret weapon to work properly. You must apply it with a glitter adhesive or cosmetic glue, otherwise it simply won't stick and you'll end up with a face full of fallout! 🚨

The absolute golden rule for applying both types of glitter comes down to your technique. Never apply glitter in a rubbing motion, as that destroys your base makeup and creates an uneven mess. Instead, always use a gentle pressing motion to pat the sparkle onto the lid and lock it perfectly in place.

Which team are you: Team Pressed or Team Loose? Let us know your thoughts in the comments
